provenance.operatorDescription: Rewrites defendant person names (and legal-entity organisation names) with non-ASCII text.
provenance.operatorRationale: DefendantMapper.js:167-173 builds `name` by joining firstName/middleName/lastName with a space and calling trim(). Java String.trim() strips codepoints <= U+0020 while JavaScript String.prototype.trim() strips the full Unicode whitespace set — they disagree on U+00A0 and friends. Zero-width and astral-plane characters additionally probe surrogate handling.

operatorDetail.why: Latin-1 supplement and precomposed forms. The transform copies these strings through byte-for-byte (DefendantMapper.js:167-173 only joins and trims), so the port must too. NOTE: normalisation-insensitive COMPARISON is a separate question and is NOT licensed — see comparator-vectors unicode/nfc-vs-nfd-in-value
